einzeiler: Five-year-old Sailor Hayes drowned in South Carolina, leading to her parents' arrest.
kurzfassung: Five-year-old Sailor Hayes, a nonverbal autistic child, was found dead in a South Carolina river after her parents reported she wandered off from a vacation rental. Investigators discovered that Sailor's Project Lifesaver tracking bracelet had been physically removed and left behind in Virginia, leading authorities to launch a search based on false information. Both parents, who have a history of child neglect and drug-related charges, were arrested in Tennessee and denied bond.
stichpunkte: Five-year-old Sailor Hayes disappeared from a vacation rental in Georgetown County, South Carolina, after her father reported she wandered away.
Search efforts were hindered when authorities realized Sailor's Project Lifesaver transmitter had been cut off and left at the family home in Virginia.
Sailor's body was recovered the following morning from the Waccamaw River behind the rental property.
John and Jordan Hayes were arrested in Tennessee the day after their daughter's body was found.
Court records revealed a prior history of child neglect and drug use, including an August 2023 incident where two children tested positive for methadone and methamphetamine.
In February 2026, Jordan Hayes was charged with public intoxication and child neglect after a juvenile was found in a freezing, locked vehicle.
A South Carolina magistrate judge denied bond for both parents, citing the egregious nature of the charges and their criminal history.
beschreibung:
Five-year-old Saylor Hayes disappeared from a vacation rental near Pawleys Island, triggering a massive search that ended in tragedy when her body was found in the Waccamaw River. But investigators soon discovered something deeply troubling: the Project Lifesaver device meant to help locate Saylor was back at her family’s home in Virginia. As questions grew about how it got there, attention turned toward Saylor’s parents and the strange circumstances surrounding her disappearance.
